name: The Breather holds its breath
notes: N1110 (Caliche history, the Breather). Played by FS47Breather when the player has stood three seconds on foot at the cave tour gate west of Main Street, after 02:00, at most once a week (the town keeps breather_w<week>) and once a night asked; the odds below make it rare. The cave's own draft stops for as long as the silence beat's secs (FS47Breather reads them, 1 to 15) and the night's crickets and wind with it, then both come back over a few seconds. Nothing else: no thought, no line, no finding, no map mark. Deniable.
